title: Novaire
subtitle: Luxury Chauffeur & Supercar Hire
overview: Novaire is a luxury showcase site for chauffeured and self-drive supercar hire — weddings, galas, airport transfers, and film production — built with Nuxt 4 as a fast, SEO-ready marketing platform.
challenge: Present a high-end fleet and service offering in a way that feels premium and trustworthy, while making it easy for clients to browse vehicles and request tailored quotes without friction.
solution: Designed and built a static-first Nuxt site with a curated fleet catalogue, service-led storytelling, multi-step quote form with email delivery, and structured SEO across every page.

sections.title: The build
sections.content: A prerendered Nuxt 4 site with Tailwind-driven brand styling, optimised imagery via @nuxt/image, individual fleet pages with editorial galleries, a guided quote form backed by Resend/Formspree, JSON-LD for search, cookie-consent-aware analytics, and legal pages — deployed for production at novaire.co.uk.
